earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 ex991-9302026.htm EX-99.1 Document PRESS RELEASE COMCAST REPORTS 3rd QUARTER 2026 RESULTS PHILADELPHIA - October 22, 2026… Comcast Corporation (NASDAQ: CMCSA) today reported results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. “ We are taking decisive steps to strengthen our businesses and unlock the full potential of their structural advantages, " said Brian L. Roberts and Mike Cavanagh, co-CEOs of Comcast Corporation. " In Connectivity & Platforms, our near-term financial results reflect the investments we're making to navigate an increasingly dynamic environment. We're encouraged by improving customer satisfaction, strong conversion of free wireless lines to paid relationships, growing adoption of premium wireless plans across our 10.6 million total wireless lines and healthy growth in Business Services, led by Enterprise, where there is substantial opportunity ahead. At the same time, we're transforming our operations to move faster, improve efficiency and fully capitalize on the strength of our businesses. In Content & Experiences, Peacock delivered its second consecutive profitable quarter, generating $261 million in Adjusted EBITDA on $1.8 billion in revenue, driven by strong growth in distribution, while Universal surpassed $5 billion at the global box office, led by the record-breaking success of The Odyssey, now Universal's highest-grossing film of all time. Despite near-term cyclical headwinds in Theme Parks, we remain confident in the business's long-term growth potential. We generated $4.2 billion in free cash flow and are making meaningful progress on the separation of NBCUniversal and Sky, which remains on track to create two independent companies with the financial strength and flexibility to pursue their respective growth strategies. Total Wireless Lines Increased to 10.6 Million, Reaching Nearly 18% Penetration of Our Domestic Residential Broadband Customers and 7% of Total Addressable Wireless Lines in Our Footprint • Continued to Drive Adoption of Higher-Value Products; Nearly 45% of Our Broadband Customers Are Now on Gig-Plus Speed Tiers, Up Nearly 10 Percentage Points Year-over-Year, and Premium Unlimited Plans Represented Approximately 40% of Postpaid Phone Connects • Launched Xfinity Shield, a First-of-its-Kind Platform That Transforms Xfinity Wi-Fi into an Always-On Layer of Cybersecurity, Home and Family Protection • Business Services Connectivity Revenue Increased 2.7% to $2.6 Billion, EBITDA Increased 1.7% to $1.5 Billion and EBITDA Margin Was 55.9% • Peacock Delivered EBITDA of $261 Million, Increasing $478 Million Year-over-Year; Paid Subscribers Increased 17% Year-over-Year to 48 Million 1 • The Odyssey Premiered in July and Became Universal's Highest Grossing Film of All Time with Nearly $1.8 Billion in Worldwide Box Office Year-to-Date; Universal Became the First Studio to Reach $5 Billion at the Global Box Office in 2026; Studios EBITDA Increased 18.6% to $402 Million • Opened Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift at Universal Studios Hollywood, the Park's First-Ever High-Speed Outdoor Roller Coaster and the Fastest Roller Coaster in the Universal Destinations & Experiences Portfolio 3rd Quarter Consolidated Financial Results \ Revenue decreased 6.1% compared to the prior year period. Net Income Attributable to Comcast increased 3.5%. Adjusted Net Income decreased 7.3%. Adjusted EBITDA decreased 5.8%. On a pro forma basis to reflect the Versant separation, which was completed on January 2, 2026, and the sale of our Sky operations in Germany, which was completed on May 31, 2026, revenue and Adjusted EBITDA were consistent with the prior year period. Earnings per Share (EPS) increased 7.2% to $0.97. Adjusted EPS decreased 4.0% to $1.07 . Capital Expenditures were consistent at $3.1 billion . Connectivity & Platforms’ capital expenditures increased 3.6% to $2.4 billion , primarily reflecting higher spending on customer premise equipment. Content & Experiences' capital expenditures decreased 10.6% to $639 million. Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities was $7.9 billion. Free Cash Flow was $4.2 billion. Dividends. Comcast paid dividends totaling $1.2 billion. As previously announced, Comcast suspended its share repurchase program beginning in the third quarter and expects the pause to remain in place through the proposed separation of its businesses into two independent publicly traded companies. Revenue for Residential Connectivity & Platforms decreased compared to the prior year period, primarily reflecting lower video and domestic broadband revenue, partially offset by higher domestic wireless equipment, domestic wireless service, international connectivity and advertising revenue. Domestic broadband revenue decreased due to lower average rates and a decline in the number of domestic broadband customers. Domestic wireless service revenue increased, reflecting growth in the customer base and the conversion of promotional free lines to paid service. Domestic wireless equipment revenue increased, driven by higher device sales. International connectivity revenue increased due to higher wireless revenue, primarily reflecting higher equipment revenue. Video revenue decreased primarily due to a decline in the number of video customers. Advertising revenue increased primarily due to higher domestic political advertising and higher revenue from our advanced advertising business, partially offset by lower international advertising and lower domestic nonpolitical advertising. Other revenue decreased primarily due to lower residential wireline voice revenue, driven by a decline in the number of customers. 3 Adjusted EBITDA for Residential Connectivity & Platforms decreased due to lower revenue, partially offset by lower operating expenses. Programming expenses decreased primarily due to a decline in the number of domestic video customers. Non-programming expenses increased primarily reflecting an increase in direct product costs, mainly due to growth in our domestic wireless business, partially offset by lower technical and support costs. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 35.9%. reference.summary: Comcast Corporation operates as a media and technology company worldwide. The company operates through Residential Connectivity & Platforms, Business Services Connectivity, Media, Studios, and Theme Parks segments. Its Residential Connectivity & Platforms segment provides residential broadband and wireless connectivity services, residential and business video services, sky-branded entertainment television networks, and advertising. The Business Services Connectivity segment offers connectivity services for small business locations, which include broadband, wireline voice, and wireless services; and ethernet network services for medium-sized customers and larger enterprises.
